scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, primary CTA, and visual elements

steps.description: Open the root URL (/) in a browser
steps.context: User arrives at the landing page from any source

steps.description: Check that a prominent headline communicating the core value proposition is visible
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Check that a supporting subheadline with additional context is present
steps.context: Subheadline should be below the main headline

steps.description: Check that a primary CTA button (Get Started/Start Shortening) is visible and clickable
steps.context: CTA should be prominent and guide users to registration

steps.description: Check that a secondary CTA link (Learn More) is present
steps.context: Secondary CTA should scroll to features section

test_cases.expected: Hero section is rendered with headline containing value proposition text
Subheadline text is visible and provides context about the service
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'Start Shortening' exists and is clickable
Link with text 'Learn More' exists
User is navigated to /register page
